scope: US federal cloud controls, independent audit of purposively selected systems; no population extrapolation

sources.license: US federal government authored text generally public domain in United States; no third-party graphics reproduced; original factual summaries only

observations.measure: Selected cloud systems for which continuous monitoring practice was fully performed
observations.population: Eight selected cloud systems at four selected federal agencies
observations.note: GAO purposive sample; not a government-wide rate.

observations.measure: Selected cloud systems with fully implemented service-level agreement practice
observations.population: Eight selected cloud systems at four selected federal agencies
observations.note: Three remaining systems lacked consistent definition of metrics, measurement and enforcement.

observations.measure: Systems for which agencies partially implemented the assessed set of three key cloud practices
observations.population: Eight selected cloud systems at four selected federal agencies
observations.note: The other three systems were fully implemented at agency level: two in one agency and one in another; not evidence of an actual breach.

observations.measure: GAO recommendations to State, Veterans Affairs and Small Business Administration on cloud security practices
observations.population: Recommendations in GAO-26-108443; not agencies or substantiated violations
observations.note: VA agreed; State neither agreed nor disagreed; SBA provided no comments at report publication.

events.event: GAO published assessment of eight selected cloud systems across State, Transportation, VA and SBA, issuing 12 recommendations to three agencies
events.note: Recommendations are not sanctions or adjudications.

causality: No inference about wrongdoing, actual data breaches, service deterioration or public trust; descriptive sample only.
limitations: Purposive eight-system sample cannot estimate national prevalence.
No evidence of actual breach, individual culpability or citizen trust outcome.
The three cloud security practices are distinct and should not be summed as independent system counts.
